title: Assertions That Guard Assumptions
prompt: Implement `size_t sizeof_int_ok(void)` guarded by a `_Static_assert(sizeof(int) >= 4, ...)` at file scope (return sizeof(int)), and `int version_at_least(int v)` returning 1 iff __STDC_VERSION__ (an integer constant) is >= v. The build itself proves the first; the second lets tests interrogate the standard level.

tests.name: int is at least 32 bits here
tests.hint: The static assertion compiles only if the assumption holds; sizeof confirms 4 on this platform.

tests.name: standard level
tests.hint: __STDC_VERSION__ 202311L on this C23 toolchain clears any C11-or-later check.
